svg.title: Zip-tie hole diameter
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with hand size set to Custom, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: zip-tie hole diameter at 7 mm: widens every zip-tie hole. Marked in red: 1, the zip-tie holes: the four small holes beside the pocket. 2, the wing openings: the two openings beside the pocket. The body edge, the pocket, the seat and the wall notch stay where they were.
